The family history sentence says prostate cancer and diabetes mellitus were "both reported by his father"; it does not say whether the father or another relative has these conditions.

The Fig. 4 caption says a left lung lobectomy is visible in the lingula area and names ventilation-perfusion scans for panel C, while the text places this CT before the decision for lobectomy and calls it a contrast-enhanced thoracic CT.

The workup for other sites after "the diagnosis of disseminated cryptococcosis" is narrated before the platelet drop and blood-culture confirmation on hospital day 10, and the abstract places the disseminated cryptococcosis diagnosis on day 10. Its order relative to those events is not stated.
The smoking sentence reports a smoking index of 10 alongside 10 years of smoking at 20 cigarettes daily; pack-years is not reported and was not calculated.

Hospital-day numbers (day 23 neurological decline, day 38 pneumonectomy, day 39 to 44 events) and days counted from symptom onset (22 and 43) use different anchors, and the first intubation to tracheostomy interval is not stated beyond "13 days" of ventilation.
